name: Nuppeppō
description: A blob-like Japanese yokai resembling a soft, wrinkled mass of flesh, said to wander abandoned temples and graveyards. Depicted in classic Edo-period yokai scrolls including Toriyama Sekien's Gazu Hyakki Yagyō (1776).

aliases.name: Nikujin (肉人)
aliases.meaning: 'Meat-person'; related figure recorded in 1609 at Sunpu Castle

origin: Japan; an Edo-period yokai documented in classical Japanese yokai scrolls.
